transport: solution/main.py reads persistent UTF-8 JSON lines and writes exactly one finite JSON object per request. Protocol responses occupy stdout; diagnostics may use stderr.
execution: Each final condition uses a fresh process and private chroot as UID/GID 65534. Runtime and solution are read-only; scratch is writable. The trusted scorer, SDK and reference pool stay outside the child filesystem. Network, new processes and namespace access are denied.
software: Offline CPU Python 3.11 with the default numerical libraries. Bundle pure-Python dependencies and model assets inside solution/. The runtime permits threads; forked workers and external executables are unavailable.
final_inputs: Each condition sends target-free candidate features, authorized initial labels and accepted query feedback. The reference pool remains under verifier/test/data/.

choose_request.feedback: null initially; previous authorized query response thereafter

choose_response.candidate_id: candidate string, or null for normal early stop

scoring: Mean unique discoveries satisfying abs(gap)<5 over ten initial conditions on one final candidate pool disjoint from development. Initial labels and cache hits contribute zero discoveries; cached queries spend zero new-query budget. The strict threshold excludes both -5 and +5.
curve_diagnostic: For each condition, sum D(q) for q=1..100 divided by 100. After normal early stopping, carry forward the number of discoveries already confirmed.
first_hit_diagnostic: First new query with a hit; report budget+1=101 if none.
